selection_basis: Technical completion only, fixed before reading any new SfM surface or image quality metrics
eligibility: Selected predecessor has an actual closed native training FAIL receipt, a recorded resource failure and successful fresh-initialization first step. Its native process and GPU work must have ended. A running or successful training is not replaced.
recovery_changes: Release previous-step parameter gradients before the next forward, after the previous optimizer and densification have finished; retain the original zero_grad before backward
Serialize the same native PLY header, field order and float32 bytes in bounded chunks
Preserve the already validated v2 CPU depth cache and pinned Adam-moment storage
required_proofs: Frozen source membership and hashes, exact v2 train.py, exact original renderer and loss/optimizer expressions
CPU native-versus-streamed PLY entire-file SHA equality including 61 fields, SH ordering, negative zero and multiple chunk boundaries
Tiny CUDA parameter, optimizer-moment and step-counter equivalence with existing gradients and growth/pruning; run on an actually available GPU before sealing training
Original scientific config and selected SfM/input bytes unchanged
Closed predecessor failure and its entire earlier attempt history bound by SHA
main_result_selection: For each region retain the selected predecessor if it completes. If eligible for this one additional attempt, report that attempt as the fixed main producer regardless of quality or success; retain the predecessor failure and cost. Never fall back to the better-looking trajectory.
historical_prefix_policy: contracts/sfm_prefix8000_diagnostic_v1.json remains immutable and uses its original selected predecessor trajectories. Any 8000 result from a fresh retry is a different trajectory and must not replace or be spliced into that prefix diagnostic.
stop_rule: After this additional fresh attempt fails, perform no further fresh training retry or outcome-driven point cap, loss, protection, camera or resolution change under this experiment. Report missing main results explicitly and complete the fixed available prefix diagnostic.
limitations: Tiny equivalence fixtures do not prove full CUDA training trajectory bitwise equality or guarantee completion
This is a resource implementation variation and its timing is reported separately
A memory failure is not evidence that Anchor is geometrically necessary or that a source-selection algorithm is superior
The SfM/no-Anchor path jointly changes initialization, stage and schedules, and remains ALS-supervised
